items.reason: Describes unchecked null delegates in the getSubGroupsStream overloads, a separate problem from getSubGroupsCount returning null. Fixing the stream methods would not fix issue #01.
The reader is not joined before the assertion, allowing an in-flight failure to be recorded after the test passes.
Describes getSubGroupsCount returning null after concurrent deletion, violating its non-null contract and risking unboxing NPEs.
Describes missing reader synchronization, including the missing join before asserting, which lets the regression test pass without observing a concurrent failure.
Describes the missing reader-thread join that allows assertions to run before all reader exceptions have been collected.
